 Brooks Nader’s tennis bracelet looks like real diamonds, but it’s $21 on Amazon 
 By 
 Hannah Southwick 
 Published 
 Nov. 16, 2026, 10:27 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Brooks Nader wore a classic LBD to the star-studded Amazon Holiday Soirée last week. 
 Brooks Nader/Amazon/Pavoi 
 Page Six may be compensated and/or receive an affiliate commission if you click or buy through our links. Featured pricing is subject to change.
 Brooks Nader is starting off winter with a little ice.
 The “Baywatch” star looked every bit the chic New Yorker at Amazon’s star-studded Holiday Soirée in Manhattan last week, wearing a classic LBD — Owin’s Mock Neck Dress , which rings in at under $40 — paired with subtle sparkle.
 But while her Pavoi 14K Gold Plated Classic Tennis Bracelet looks like fine jewelry, it’s actually less than $21 (and currently the No. 1 best-selling women’s tennis bracelet on Amazon, to boot).
 Pavoi 14K Gold Plated Classic Tennis Bracelet 
 Pavoi 
 BUY NOW $20.95 
 Owin Mock Neck Dress 
 Owen 
 BUY NOW $38.99 
 Over 2,000 have sold in the last month alone, and the bracelet’s racked up a 4.3-star average out of over 32,000 (!) reviews.
 “It is just the right size without being too discreet or too gaudy,” one satisfied shopper wrote, while another added, “I live in a wealthy area so I am sure everyone thinks it is real.”
 The “Love Thy Nader” star isn’t the only celebrity wearing it, as Kyle Richards once said on Amazon Live that it “looks 100% real.” 
 “The quality of this is great,” she told viewers, raving that the accessible sparkler looks “very, very good.”
 Madison LeCroy also highlighted the bracelet in a Page Six Style interview earlier this year, saying it “just looks rich.”

 For her part, Nader matched the bracelet to the Blahanna Moissanite Earrings — a similarly sparkly style that’s currently on sale for under $30 — and Florideco 14K Gold Plated Stackable Rings .
